title: Eastern Chalukya society: more on faith, schools, grants

boxes.title: Administration & society: more
items: Model: ==**Badami Chalukyas**==; Brahmadeya + agrahara grants from the Badami model
Village head also **Gramani**; **Palnadu** also a nadu
Sthanadhipati: temple **land endowments** from kings + vassals
**Jayasimha II**: ==**Koya Kottalu**== drawn into Brahmanical fold; Panduranga subdued the **Boyas**
Trade with ==eastern islands== under Rajaraja Narendra

boxes.title: Arts & artists: more
items: Musicians, dancers attached to **temples and courts**
Chellavva also "**Samasta Gandharva Vidya Kovida**"; court singer, dancer; **2 kandikas** of land

boxes.title: Current & later
items: Pillars: Eastern Chalukya + **15th-century** eras; in **South Indian Inscriptions Vol. VI**
Later, ==**Kakatiya** age==: **Kalamukha + Virashaiva** persecution of Jains; Potlacheruvu attacked
